response.justification: The candidate is a broadly experienced, versatile senior engineer with nearly 20 years of software development across web, backend, and systems work, but the profile diverges significantly from this role's core requirements. C++ experience amounts to roughly a year (National Instruments and a thesis project) versus the required 8 years, and most recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js product engineering rather than cloud compute platforms or large-scale infrastructure. There is also no demonstrated formal technical-leadership experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers, making the fit weak despite strong general engineering craftsmanship.
strengths: Deep low-latency systems experience at Sociomantic handling millions of HTTP requests per second with async I/O and high-performance databases
Long track record of software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and community teaching/workshops showing mentoring aptitude
Broad full-stack and infrastructure exposure including Kubernetes, Docker, AWS CDK, and DevOps tooling
concerns: Falls far short of the 8-year C++ requirement; primary languages are TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No formal technical-leadership role leading teams or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers; career has been IC-focused
Recent experience is product/web engineering rather than cloud compute platforms, distributed systems, or hardware/storage architecture

key_factors.factor: Limited cloud-platform and technical-leadership track record
Strong systems programming and mentoring/teaching background
